notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least X +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
